sources.title: Ornith 1.5 9B: Local Test Results Expose a Benchmark Gap
sources.snippet: What is Ornith 1.5 9B and does it live up to its benchmarks? Ornith 1.5 9B is a dense, 9-billion-parameter language model built by ornith-ai, designed to run on a single GPU or even mobile hardware in quantized GGUF format.
